pageTitle: Moka Foods Potato Cake Pack Line
headline: Every bag checked, not a sample.
formProduct: Frozen potato cakes and battered foods
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to Laverton North
heroLede: Frozen products in similar bags look alike on the line, so the seal, the label and the date are what keep each run right. Here's what a camera check could look like at the end of your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every bag is sealed straight across, with no crease and no batter caught in the seal. An open bag in a freezer means freezer burn and a complaint.
labelLede: A bag of potato cakes and a bag of battered seafood sticks can look much the same at line speed, and one of them carries fish. The camera checks every bag carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every bag. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Film offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four creased seals in fifteen minutes on Line 1. Check the bag sealer.
